sample_unit: paired treatment ratings across 135 patient scenarios

links.outcome: LLM treatment appropriateness ratings versus AAOS guideline ratings for carpal tunnel syndrome scenarios
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o under-recommended steroid injection (-2.7) and carpal tunnel release (-1.8), over-recommended electrodiagnostic studies (+4.5); Gemini similar pattern; Spearman Rho 0.782 (Gemini) vs 0.53 (ChatGPT)
links.quote: Compared to AAOS guidelines, ChatGPT-4o under-recommended steroid injection (mean error -2.7 ± 1.2; P < .001) and carpal tunnel release (mean error -1.8 ± 1.7; P < .001) while over-recommending electrodiagnostic studies (mean error 4.5 ± 3.8; P < .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro on carpal tunnel syndrome clinical scenarios compared to AAOS guidelines, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
